Resolves #20329

A blog post, a scaffolding-script change or a `neo-agent-skills` bump no longer runs the engine e2e tier (4 shards) and the Brain-gated tier (10 shards).

- `apps/portal/resources/data/blog.json` and `buildScripts/{create,helpers,release}/` leave the E2E boundary as deny-lists, so a new path still admits it. `blog.json` is read only by the lazily loaded news/blog view, which no e2e spec opens. The rest of the portal's data stays in, because `seo.json` loads on every route. A unit arm reds when either premise stops holding.
- `package-lock.json` gets the same both-refs content read as `package.json`, without the entries of packages no browser tier loads.
- A pull request outside the boundary selects the Brain tier `none`. One job reports the skip with its reason and provisions nothing.
- On a `dev` push the Brain tier always runs in full. Unit, components and the engine tier follow the push's own diff, which for a merge is the merged PR's. The output contract is on #20329.

Replayed over the 346 PRs merged since 2026-10-13: 25 no longer run both tiers, 92 no longer run a Brain shard, and e2e runner time drops from 15,163 to 13,569 minutes (−10.5 %).

Evidence: L2 (unit arms run the committed classifier against mocks, plus a corpus replay with each PR's real `package.json` and lock) → L3 required for AC-4's "under a minute" (a live docs-only PR run). Residual: AC-4 live timing, Residual-Owner: #20328.

Prescription checked: `.github/workflows/classify-test-scope.yml` owns the concern. It is the one shared classifier; `e2eCiSelection.mjs` owns populations, not admission.

agent-preflight is not hosted here. These baseline checks ran instead: `check-ticket-archaeology`, `check-file-sizes`, `check-guard-ci-parity`, `check-relative-links`, `lint-guides` (Brain `dev` 7fba49d8) and the pre-commit hooks.

## Deltas from ticket

- A superseded attempt also selects `none`. It used to select `smoke`, but a stale run certifies nothing either way.
- The classifier no longer emits `smoke`, yet `e2eCiSelection.mjs` and the Brain matrix can still select it. #20330's selective runs will decide whether `BRAIN_SMOKE` stays as an always-on canary or goes, so this PR deletes nothing that leaf names.
- `readAtBothRefs()` now serves both content facets. Fork coordinates for `package.json` work as before, and their arms pass unchanged.
- AC-7 adds a new classifier output, `e2e_boundary_report`, which the Brain skip step prints. It was @neo-opus-ada's condition for `none`: the smoke shard also caught classifier misses, so a miss must now show on the PR that carries it.

## Test Evidence

**Red-first:** against the unchanged classifier, the 7 new or changed arms failed, each for its intended reason, and the 53 existing arms passed. Review RA-1 was red-first too: the `seo.json` and `buildScripts/docs` admission arms failed on `781a15a570`, and the reachability guard passes on today's tree.

**Corpus replay** at `ec4d932784`: I ran the old script (`origin/dev`) and the new one over the 346 PRs merged from 2026-10-13 to 2026-11-05, using each PR's real `package.json` and `package-lock.json` at its base and head.

| | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| PRs running both e2e tiers in full | 279 | 254 |
| PRs running a Brain smoke shard | 67 | 0 |
| PRs selecting Brain `none` | 0 | 92 |
| e2e runner-minutes (engine 3.68, Brain 3.87 min per shard) | 15,163 | 13,569 |

All 25 flips fall in the ticket's rows:
- `blog.json` (each blog post): 6;
- `neo-agent-skills`-only bumps: 12;
- `buildScripts/create`, each with its own unit spec: 7. The one `buildScripts/docs` PR no longer flips.

No PR flips toward running more.
